department: Doctoral Programme in Ecology, Evolution and Environmental Sustainability in Society (ELOISA)

deadline.value: The programme admits four times a year; the 2026-27 rounds close 16 November 2026, 25 January 2027 and 15 April 2027, and the earliest is listed.
deadline.quote: until 16 November 2026 at 03:00 PM EEST | Application periods in spring 2027: | 12-25 January 2027 | 2-15 April 2027

also.quote: The programme admits new doctoral researchers four times year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Each applicant must have supervisors when applying, and 2-3 thesis supervisors with doctorates are needed for a study right.
supervisor.quote: A doctoral researcher must have 2–3 thesis supervisors with doctorate degrees when applying for a study right

funding.value: Secured first-year funding must be confirmed by the main supervisor; the page does not say admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: In ELOISA, the applicant needs to have secured funding for the first year

entry_route.value: Applicants need a second-cycle university degree or an equivalent foreign education.

notes: Covers ecology, evolution and environmental sciences, per the programme's field list. Secured funding for the first year is required, and this page does not say whether admitted students are funded.
